rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the provided 3AA label, but the image itself is somewhat indistinct and does not clearly support the very specific claims about ICM location, tight TE cohesion, and zona thinning; some visible-feature overstatement is present.
Thoroughly integrates maternal age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor, endometrium, BMI, sperm quality, and lifestyle factors with embryo morphology and prognosis.
Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, especially around age-related aneuploidy versus good morphology, though a few quantitative claims and modifiers are somewhat speculative.

Mostly aligned on single embryo transfer and age-related counseling, but recommendations such as ERA after one failed transfer and some strong claims about endometrial thickness/alcohol effects go beyond standard evidence-based guideline support.

Provides clear practical next steps for transfer strategy, cavity/tubal evaluation, lifestyle modification, and future-cycle planning, though some suggested interventions may be more aggressive than necessary.
